meta.design: GD Cosmic Protocols (CH-like). Active Skills + Starlink Tags + Anomaly enabled.
notes: All multipliers are additive in percent form unless specified. Use BigNumber for damage/gold math.
Skill-related protocols target the provided skill IDs (s_clickstorm, s_powersurge, s_lucky, s_metal, s_goldclicks, s_darkritual, s_superclicks, s_energize, s_reload).
Starlink Tags: tagsByMinerId -> tagCount; tagMultiplier = 1 + tagCount * tagPower. tagPower is affected by starlink_tag_amplifier.

protocols.name: Cosmic Geode Protocol
protocols.description: Adds +5% chance to find a Cosmic Geode (Treasure Chest), which gives 10x minerals.

protocols.name: Core Singularity
protocols.description: Adds +11% global DPS per Stellar Fragment spent into this protocol (additive stacking).

protocols.name: Quantum Overdrive
protocols.description: Increases miner DPS by +10% per level.

protocols.name: Entropy Engine
protocols.description: Increases damage dealt to boss-type enemies by +12% per level.

protocols.name: Dark Matter Flow
protocols.description: Boosts idle DPS per level with diminishing returns (starts strong and gradually softens).

protocols.name: Photon Strike Matrix
protocols.description: Increases tap/click damage by +20% per level.

protocols.name: Manual Override
protocols.description: Converts 2% of total DPS into added tap damage per level (tap scales with your DPS).

protocols.name: Momentum Combo Core
protocols.description: Adds a stacking tap combo bonus: each consecutive tap increases tap damage by +0.01% per level. Resets if you stop tapping.

protocols.name: Precision Lattice
protocols.description: Improves critical taps. Each level adds +1% crit chance and +5% crit multiplier (relative).

protocols.name: Astro Extraction Grid
protocols.description: Increases all mineral gains by +5% per level.

protocols.name: Void Harvest Protocol
protocols.description: Increases boss mineral rewards by +20% per level.

protocols.name: Anomaly Attunement
protocols.description: Increases anomaly boss spawn chance by +1% per level (applied on top of the base 25% chance).

protocols.name: Anomaly Fragment Yield
protocols.description: Increases Stellar Fragment rewards from anomaly bosses with diminishing returns (strong early, softer late).

protocols.name: Temporal Acceleration
protocols.description: Speeds up sector progression by +8% per level.

protocols.name: Starlink Tag Amplifier
protocols.description: Increases Starlink Tag power by +0.05 per level (adds to tagPower).

protocols.name: Starlink Tag Foundry
protocols.description: Increases the chance to drop a Starlink Tag from anomaly bosses by +1% per level (supports pity timer if implemented).

protocols.name: Rhythm Strike Stabilizer
protocols.description: Increases Rhythm Strike duration by +1s per level.

protocols.name: Drill Overdrive Stabilizer
protocols.description: Increases Drill Overdrive duration by +1s per level.

protocols.name: Precision Poke Stabilizer
protocols.description: Increases Precision Poke duration by +1s per level.

protocols.name: Moon Scan Stabilizer
protocols.description: Increases Moon Scan duration by +1s per level.

protocols.name: Comet Rush Stabilizer
protocols.description: Increases Comet Rush duration by +1s per level.

protocols.name: Chisel Impact Stabilizer
protocols.description: Increases Chisel Impact duration by +1s per level.

protocols.name: Cooldown Dilation
protocols.description: Reduces cooldowns by 5% per level (multiplicative on remaining cooldown).

protocols.name: Runner Boost Efficiency
protocols.description: Increases Runner Boost's next-skill amplification by +5% per level (adds to the multiplier).

protocols.name: Specialist Reset Tuning
protocols.description: Increases Specialist Reset cooldown reduction by +5 minutes per level.

protocols.name: Deep Protocol Persistence
protocols.description: Increases Deep Protocol's permanent DPS stack bonus by +1% per level (resets on Prestige/Rewind as designed).

protocols.name: Reality Stabilizer
protocols.description: Reduces enemy HP growth in deep space by 4% per level (optional balancing tool).

protocols.name: Warp Drive
protocols.description: Reduces the number of monsters required per zone by 1 per level (Minimum 2 monsters).

protocols.name: Silent Observer
protocols.description: Increases DPS by +25% per level when Idle (no clicks for 60 seconds).
